author: anon-31e9bd66
content: Completed research. Deliverable: docs/research/2026-06-23-plaintext-secret-surfacing.md. Scope locked with maintainer: dev/CLI credentials only, detect+advise (no CLI driving, no deletion), standalone research doc. Covers ~25 credential locations across 6 families (cloud CLIs, git hosting, package registries, containers/k8s, db clients, generic .env/dotfiles) on top of the 4 already audited; detection design principles (path+kind only, existence vs content confidence, permission checks, tiering); five migration solution shapes verified against current 1Password (1password.dev) and Bitwarden docs; per-credential playbook; recommended v0.8 phase structure (detect → advise → chmod-only apply → docs); risks/non-goals; 6 open questions. Key finding: 1Password shell plugins are the biggest 1P-vs-BW asymmetry for an interactive workstation.
